subject: Error in fitMeasures(object, fit.measures = "default") :    object 'logl.H1' not found

messages.author: 8e3795c93b647bff
messages.subject: Error in fitMeasures(object, fit.measures = "default") :    object 'logl.H1' not found
parts:
Hi all,

While running SEM, I can get the complete output when I do: summary(modelB.fit, rsq=T,standardized=TRUE)

However, when I do summary(modelB.fit, rsq=T,standardized=TRUE,fit.measures=TRUE), that is, add the fit.measures field, I get the error:

Error in fitMeasures(object, fit.measures = "default") :    object 'logl.H1' not found


Can anybody help me out?

Thanks a lot!
